show.fullName: Fantasy World Adventures Mega Park! The Musical
show.tagline: A hilarious new musical comedy created by Abbie Freeston and Matthew Stanley, taking you on the rollercoaster that is love, loss, and being a constant disappointment to your parents.
show.description:
Fantasy World Adventures Mega Park! The Musical (FWAMP!) is a hilarious new musical comedy created by Abbie Freeston and Matthew Stanley. Our story follows Teddy Mega, a theme park nepo baby who wants to change his future. After the tragic nobbling of his Dad, Teddy Mega is the newly appointed CEO of Fantasy World Adventures Mega Park! theme park. He's trying to do it all - keep his mum happy, bring in new ideas and solve problems amongst the staff. The only problem is, Teddy has a secret: his one true passion is to become the theme park's infamous mascot instead. This brand-new comedy musical is hilariously shameless, and showcases the rollercoaster that is love, life, and being a constant disappointment to your parents.

After a 5-star run at the stage@leeds theatre in June 2025, FWAMP! is heading to the Edinburgh Fringe for a two week run at theSpace on the Mile from August 17-29th.
